content.content: {"result":"{\"ok\": true, \"messages\": [{\"ts\": \"1760125440.959149\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Team, please welcome *<@EMPLOYEE_0035_SLACK_ID>* to harmonygames. She will lead our Telegram distribution strategy, starting with a focused experiment on Domino Delights.\\n\\nThere is some technical work to enable this, which <@EMPLOYEE_0025_SLACK_ID> and a few folks will handle. I had the privilege of working with [PERSON_NAME_0133] at Super Evil for years, and she is one of the most kick-ass colleagues I have worked with. She is a firefighter, a veteran at community building on chat platforms since the early Facebook days, and she somehow balances life in Norway with horses and kids while still delivering at lightening speed.  For now, she will put a small amount of her time into us but I\\u2019m hoping that this will turn into something much bigger!\\n\\nPlease give her a warm welcome. You will meet her in one of the company meetings early next week.\", \"channel\": \"C05KNDCHAAG\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1756915276.826179\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Gemini says There are no restrictions on telegram\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1756915276.826179\", \"reply_count\": 1, \"reply_users_count\": 1, \"latest_reply\": \"1756915287.176829\"}, {\"ts\": \"1760117682.248869\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Talked to [PERSON_NAME_0133] - she is in for DD on Telegram\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\", \"reactions\": [{\"count\": 1, \"name\": \"pray::skin-tone-6\", \"users\": [\"EMPLOYEE_0025_SLACK_ID\"]}, {\"count\": 1, \"name\": \"pray\", \"users\": [\"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"]}]}, {\"ts\": \"1760309256.938589\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Board meeting mail:\\n\\n\\n[PERSON_NAME_64503] and [PERSON_NAME_1999],\\n\\nAttached please find the materials for our upcoming board meeting, scheduled for Oct 14, Tuesday at 9:00 AM PT via Google Meet.\\n\\nAhead of the meeting, I wanted to provide a brief update on the state of the company. We remain focused on Zombie Match 3D, are operating lean, and  executing with discipline. The fundraising climate is difficult, cash is tight, and we need near-term decisions to secure a path forward.\\n*What\\u2019s Been Good*\\nCompany Building\\n\\u2022 We are still hungry to win, and need to reset culture to run extra lean until breakthrough.\\n\\u2022 Executive salary freeze continues. Team downsizing from 16 to 8 by the end of October. New burn about $25K per month, unless a cash injection lands in 2 to 3 weeks.\\n\\u2022 Pursuing VC, co-dev, and engine licensing in parallel to navigate a tough funding climate.\\nProduct\\n\\u2022 Zombie Match 3D: early alpha shows a strong core loop with upside still locked. Beta launches this week.\\n\\u2022 Domino Delights: organics are decent. Traditional LTV:CAC on mobile will not work, so we plan to distribute on other platforms to drive traffic and revenue.\\n    \\u25e6 Telegram Push: signed a top community operator on a profit share, no salary, to lead non mobile app store distribution.\\n*Challenges and Focus Areas*\\nCompany Building\\n\\u2022 Bank about $157K. Runway about 2.5 months at current size. Downsizing extends the runway to March.\\n\\u2022 Fundraising climate is tough. Many first calls, few follow ups.\\n\\u2022 Common feedback: strong team, engine has limited standalone value, come back with content traction.\\nProduct and Marketing\\n\\u2022 Zombie Match: cautiously optimistic, but metrics may be short of a VC led deal or co-dev.\\n    \\u25e6 Unity metrics are volatile, with bot installs distorting signals.\\n    \\u25e6 Real time split screen is unproven. We may pivot the core while keeping the meta, which a small team can execute.\\n\\u2022 UA to prove traction is cost prohibitive. AppLovin ROAS needs about $2K per day with $30+ CPI to stabilize metrics. Our budget cannot support this, so we are exploring alternative plans with smaller budgets.\\nBest regards,\\nLeonard\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1763589315.427959\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Hi [PERSON_NAME_18599],\\nThank you for sharing the draft agreement. We are excited to move forward on a web partnership, but we will need some adjustments before we can sign.\\nBelow are the key points we would like to revise.\\n*1- Scope of platforms: web only* \\nRight now, \\u201cLicensed Platforms\\u201d includes mobile app stores. Our intent for this deal is strictly web publishing and also excluding 2 web-platforms as described below.\\n\\u2022 Please limit Licensed Platforms to HTML5 / WebGL browser distribution only (for example <http://CrazyGames.com|CrazyGames.com> and other web portals).\\n\\u2022 For the avoidance of doubt, the agreement should explicitly exclude any mobile app store or native mobile distribution. We want to keep mobile separate and reserve the option to sign a different mobile deal later if we choose.\\n\\u2022 We would like to also exclude YouTube playables and Telegram from the list. We\\u2019ll pursue those 2 web publishing paths on our own since we have good connections with the YouTube team directly and have an expert community builder on Telegram. \\n*2- Term, auto renewal, and exit flexibility*\\nWe are comfortable giving this a real shot, but the current structure creates a long lock-in with a long tail.\\n\\u2022 Initial term: 12 months is fine, but we would like to add mutual termination for convenience after an initial test period. For example: after the first 3 months from launch, either party can terminate for convenience on 30 days written notice.\\n\\u2022 Transition period: reducing the post-term transition from 6 months to 60 days would be much more workable. During that period we are fine keeping the game live and fixing critical issues, but we do not want an extended support obligation once we decide the partnership is not working.\\n*3- Transferability and assignment*\\nWe are not comfortable with a fully transferable license that can be assigned freely.\\n\\u2022 The license should be non-transferable except to your wholly owned affiliates.\\n\\u2022 Any assignment or transfer to a third party should require our prior written consent.\\n*4- Monetization and outbound links*\\nWe understand that you control monetization on your portals, but we would appreciate some room to promote our own ecosystem. Is it possible to include links to the iOS and Android store pages for Domino Delights and Zombie Match 3D? These links can follow your UX guidelines. This is not something we\\u2019ll pursue right away but we would like to reserve the options with your consent.\\n\\n*5- SDK and post termination support*\\nWe are fine integrating your SDK and keeping it up to date during the term, but not for an extended period after termination.\\n\\u2022 Please remove the requirement to update or re-integrate the SDK for up to one year after termination.We are happy to commit to updating the SDK during the transition period.\\n\\u2022 Post termination, we are happy to commit to keeping the last live version stable for a short transition period (for example 60 days), with critical bug fixes only and no new features or SDK migrations.\\nIf you can accommodate these changes, we will be in a good position to move ahead quickly. Feel free to send a revised draft, or if it is easier, we can mark up the current one and return a redline.\\nBest regards,\\nLeonard\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\", \"reactions\": [{\"count\": 1, \"name\": \"+1\", \"users\": [\"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"]}]}, {\"ts\": \"1680284026.798629\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"He did so in a telegram channel too regarding NFTs\", \"channel\": \"C04UTBZL6AX\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1721096249.079479\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"The question is whether these schemes can get wide adoption, and so far people have tried to build cool games around NFTs, or utilize a large distribution platform like Telegram here to increase adoption. But similar your typical Ponzi schemes, you kinda need a constant stream of new adopters, I'm just not sure where that's going to come from. I've been following [USERNAME_0314]'s game for a while now on a monthly basis, along with well known NFT like bored yacht club, and these things are still in a constant decay.\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1760643125.607689\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"I pushed out the plan for DD on the <#C09KU8U4DPF|telegram-dd> channel <@EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID> <@EMPLOYEE_0025_SLACK_ID>\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1733941558.829829\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"if we want to distrubute our game on telegram as an html5 game, would it work at all?\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1733941558.829829\", \"reply_count\": 3, \"reply_users_count\": 2, \"latest_reply\": \"1733942495.940209\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758653282.018019\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Talk to a friend who are doing games for telegram. \", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1759955224.799289\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"<@EMPLOYEE_0025_SLACK_ID> one thing that I heard about telegram games, for domino/solitaire type of games you can expect to have similar retention to what we see on regular mobile\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1760024851.071469\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"I\\u2019m also making some economy changes for DD to help it monetize better, I think we can ship that one tomorrow with Blake\\u2019s help. I need to make some balance changes There. I\\u2019m tallking to [PERSON_NAME_0133] tomorrow to figure out the telegram path.\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1760117925.761109\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"She needs a couple of things\\n\\u2022 We need to do something with a basic raffle system and $50 worth of crypto - some basic tech implementation needed\\n\\u2022 We need a quest/ticketing system which we already have \\n\\u2022 She recommended we shorten the tutorial to 2-3 levels max - telegram guys have no time to wait. We are already taking care of it.\\n\\u2022 Blake needs to hook up IAPs and Ads.\\n\\u2022 We need to figure out how to shorten the loading times - first time load takes forever. \\nOnce I gave her access to everything on DD we should chat with her, onboard her and help her out to set us up for success\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1760219161.099539\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"If I'm [PERSON_NAME_2000], I might interpret your product notes (Beta for ZM and Telegram for DD) as reasons to wait a few more weeks to see what metrics look like.\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1760219161.099539\", \"reply_count\": 1, \"reply_users_count\": 1, \"latest_reply\": \"1760239712.640929\"}, {\"ts\": \"1762926876.699529\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"we will move forward with them on web, the order of publication is\\nCrazyGames > msn (1 month review) > Facebook (1 month review) > wechat > others - we are excluding telegram and YouTube from the contract\\nwe are talking with their mobile arm separately - meeting to be scheduled next wednesday\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1767727583.081359\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"can one of you guys plesae approve this $500 to [PERSON_NAME_0133]? [PERSON_NAME_64503] and [PERSON_NAME_1999],

Attached please find the materials for our upcoming board meeting, scheduled for Oct 14, Tuesday at 9:00 AM PT via Google Meet.

Ahead of the meeting, I wanted to provide a brief update on the state of the company. We remain focused on Zombie Match 3D, are operating lean, and  executing with discipline. The fundraising climate is difficult, cash is tight, and we need near-term decisions to secure a path forward.
*What’s Been Good*
Company Building
• We are still hungry to win, and need to reset culture to run extra lean until breakthrough.
• Executive salary freeze continues. Team downsizing from 16 to 8 by the end of October. New burn about $25K per month, unless a cash injection lands in 2 to 3 weeks.
• Pursuing VC, co-dev, and engine licensing in parallel to navigate a tough funding climate.
Product
• Zombie Match 3D: early alpha shows a strong core loop with upside still locked. Beta launches this week.
• Domino Delights: organics are decent. Traditional LTV:CAC on mobile will not work, so we plan to distribute on other platforms to drive traffic and revenue.
    ◦ Telegram Push: signed a top community operator on a profit share, no salary, to lead non mobile app store distribution.
*Challenges and Focus Areas*
Company Building
• Bank about $157K. Runway about 2.5 months at current size. Downsizing extends the runway to March.
• Fundraising climate is tough. Many first calls, few follow ups.
• Common feedback: strong team, engine has limited standalone value, come back with content traction.
Product and Marketing
• Zombie Match: cautiously optimistic, but metrics may be short of a VC led deal or co-dev.
    ◦ Unity metrics are volatile, with bot installs distorting signals.
    ◦ Real time split screen is unproven. We may pivot the core while keeping the meta, which a small team can execute.
• UA to prove traction is cost prohibitive. AppLovin ROAS needs about $2K per day with $30+ CPI to stabilize metrics. Our budget cannot support this, so we are exploring alternative plans with smaller budgets.
Best regards,
Leonard", "channel": "C07C2866011", "user": "EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID"}, {"ts": "1763589315.427959", "type": "message", "text": "Hi [PERSON_NAME_18599],
Thank you for sharing the draft agreement. We are excited to move forward on a web partnership, but we will need some adjustments before we can sign.
Below are the key points we would like to revise.
*1- Scope of platforms: web only* 
Right now, “Licensed Platforms” includes mobile app stores. Our intent for this deal is strictly web publishing and also excluding 2 web-platforms as described below.
• Please limit Licensed Platforms to HTML5 / WebGL browser distribution only (for example <http://CrazyGames.com|CrazyGames.com> and other web portals).
• For the avoidance of doubt, the agreement should explicitly exclude any mobile app store or native mobile distribution. We want to keep mobile separate and reserve the option to sign a different mobile deal later if we choose.
• We would like to also exclude YouTube playables and Telegram from the list. We’ll pursue those 2 web publishing paths on our own since we have good connections with the YouTube team directly and have an expert community builder on Telegram. 
*2- Term, auto renewal, and exit flexibility*
We are comfortable giving this a real shot, but the current structure creates a long lock-in with a long tail.
• Initial term: 12 months is fine, but we would like to add mutual termination for convenience after an initial test period. For example: after the first 3 months from launch, either party can terminate for convenience on 30 days written notice.
• Transition period: reducing the post-term transition from 6 months to 60 days would be much more workable. During that period we are fine keeping the game live and fixing critical issues, but we do not want an extended support obligation once we decide the partnership is not working.
*3- Transferability and assignment*
We are not comfortable with a fully transferable license that can be assigned freely.
• The license should be non-transferable except to your wholly owned affiliates.
• Any assignment or transfer to a third party should require our prior written consent.
*4- Monetization and outbound links*
We understand that you control monetization on your portals, but we would appreciate some room to promote our own ecosystem. Is it possible to include links to the iOS and Android store pages for Domino Delights and Zombie Match 3D? These links can follow your UX guidelines. This is not something we’ll pursue right away but we would like to reserve the options with your consent.

*5- SDK and post termination support*
We are fine integrating your SDK and keeping it up to date during the term, but not for an extended period after termination.
• Please remove the requirement to update or re-integrate the SDK for up to one year after termination.We are happy to commit to updating the SDK during the transition period.
• Post termination, we are happy to commit to keeping the last live version stable for a short transition period (for example 60 days), with critical bug fixes only and no new features or SDK migrations.
If you can accommodate these changes, we will be in a good position to move ahead quickly. Feel free to send a revised draft, or if it is easier, we can mark up the current one and return a redline.
Best regards,

input.body:
**Canceled — Telegram push was called off in January 2026.**

Decision of record: on **Jan 6, 2026**, Leonard terminated the Telegram distribution lead's contract and confirmed the pivot — *"I terminated her contract this morning and talked to her - told her we changed directions and won't be doing telegram anytime soon."* (Slack, founders channel: https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/C07C2866011/p1767727583081359 )

Telegram was also explicitly excluded from the CrazyGames web publishing agreement (we reserved it to pursue on our own), and that self-run path was then dropped with this decision.

Canceling this master and the remaining open sub-tickets: ENG-2380, ENG-2381, ENG-2382, ENG-2383, ENG-2385, ENG-2388. ENG-2379 (MiniApp bot) and ENG-2387 (Jenkins Telegram builds) are left as **Done** — that work actually shipped before the pivot.

Cleanup done 2026-02-28 for the Sunset data handover so the exported tracker reflects reality (we are not actively building a Telegram game).

input.title: Remove Helpshift from Domino Delights & Zombie Match (winddown)
input.description:
**Master ticket — move both games off Helpshift before the subscription ends.**

**Decision / context (lives in Slack, winddown channel):**
- Feb 11, 2026 — Leonard: *"Helpshift is gonna cancel our subscription… We gotta move Domino Delights and Zombie Match off Helpshift before Feb 29th. We can just open up the email app and let players send email to [support inbox]."* (Slack winddown channel, ts 1770789534)
- Feb 27, 2026 — Leonard reconfirmed in winddown: Helpshift cutoff for both games is Feb 28 (2026 is not a leap year; "Feb 29" = end of month = Feb 28).
- Helpshift termination notice already sent; subscription marked cancelled on the shutdown subscription tracker.

**Plan / scope:** Ship a build of each game that removes the Helpshift dependency and replaces the in-game "Contact Us" flow with a plain `mailto:` that opens the device email app to the support inbox. No data export from Helpshift is needed (per Leonard's termination email).

**Status as of 2026-02-28: NOT STARTED — no code exists.** GitHub search shows only the original Helpshift *integration* PRs (GameOfDominoes #1452/#1505/#1578; match3d #277). No removal branch/PR in either repo yet.

Tracked so the record is accurate for the Sunset handover. Sub-tickets: DD (GameOfDominoes) and ZM (match3d).

input.text:
Rundown as promised — got the tracker cleaned up before we hand it to Sunset, and here's where everything actually stands. <@EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID> (+ Robert):

*1) Tracker cleanup (so the Linear export tells the truth)*
• *Telegram:* Our tracker still showed an active "Telegram DD" build. That push was called off Jan 6 when we changed directions and ended the community lead's contract. Canceled the master (ENG-2377) + the 6 open sub-tickets and left a note on the master pointing to the decision so nobody has to dig for it. The 2 tickets that actually shipped before the pivot (bot + Jenkins builds) stay Done. We are *not* handing over a record that says we're building a Telegram game.
• *UI Optimization sprint:* A pile of tickets were stuck in "PR/Validation" even though code landed back in Nov. I reconciled every one against merged PRs in GameOfDominoes:
   – *Really done → flipped to Done:* Shop, Settings, Leaderboard, Quest, Level-win, Level-lose, Axe Arena, Nathan's Treasure, all 4 mini-games (River/Memory/Tile Dozer/Lucky Drop). Core Game + Mini-Games parents are now Done.
   – *No code behind them → canceled with a note:* River Rush, Collect&win, Rate-us, Season Pass, Remove Ad, Offers, Daily Gift. These were sitting in review/validation but no PR was ever opened — the Live-Ops checklist was inaccurate. Won't be built during winddown.

*2) Helpshift move — deadline is today, and this is the one to flag* ⚠️
The plan (from Feb 11) was to move DD + Zombie Match off Helpshift by end of month and swap "Contact Us" to just open the email app to our support inbox. *Reality: no code has been written for either game yet* — GitHub only has the original integration PRs, nothing removing it. I've now tracked it properly (ENG-2438 master + ENG-2441 for DD + ZOM-2442 for ZM) so it's not lost in chat, but shipping two fresh app-store builds today isn't realistic. *Need a call from you two:* do we actually push removal builds, or just let the Helpshift subscription lapse and leave the current in-app support button dead until the apps come down? Leaning toward the latter given where we are.

*3) What Sunset is still waiting on (tracker side — mine)*
• Linear + Trello exports into their shared drive — *still owed.* I held off dropping them until the cleanup above was done so they don't inherit the phantom tickets; will export now that Linear reflects reality.
• Private-Slack-channel export question: exporting *private* channels + DMs isn't in the standard self-serve export — that needs Business+ (or Enterprise Grid) plus a requested export. Public channels export on our current plan. So yes, private-channel export = the upgrade. Worth confirming with Slack before we pay for anything, since we may not need the private channels at all.

*4) CrazyGames*
Publishing agreement signed early December (web only — CrazyGames → MSN → FB → WeChat; Telegram + YouTube carved out for us). *Integration never started* — no branch, no PR, and nothing tracked in Linear or Trello. Their mobile arm is a separate conversation. Net: signed, zero engineering work done.

*5) Other genuinely-open engineering items* (honestly still In Progress, likely moot in winddown but flagging so they're not a surprise): ENG-2363 sign-in splash-screen hang (bug), ENG-2345 addressables re-download/storage, ENG-2396 forced-ads kill switch, ENG-2023 Bomb Fire cinematic VFX. None of these are blockers for the shutdown.

tl;dr: tracker is now honest and safe to export; Helpshift removal is the only live deadline and it needs a keep-or-kill decision from you today.
